qe: Consider the following statements regarding the lithological basements, genetic sequences, and macro-economic mineralizations of the Dharwar and Vindhyan cratonic systems in India:
qh: भारत के धारवाड़ और विंध्यन क्रेटोनिक प्रणालियों के शैलवैज्ञानिक बेसमेंट, अनुवांशिक अनुक्रमों और व्यापक-आर्थिक खनिजीकरण के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
se: The Dharwar rock system represents the premier metalliferous reservoir of the country, preserving both primary high-grade ferrous and non-ferrous mineralizations.
The Vindhyan range formations are predominantly structured via aqueous sedimentation, yielding massive non-metallic reserves like limestone, sands, and china clay.
Fluvial and structural limestone matrices excavated from the Vindhyan horizons operate as the fundamental baseline raw input for the domestic copper smelting industry.
sh: धारवाड़ शैल प्रणाली देश के प्रमुख धातुमय भंडार का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है, जो प्राथमिक उच्च-ग्रेड लौह और अलौह दोनों खनिजीकरणों को सुरक्षित रखती है।
विंध्यन श्रेणी की संरचनाएं मुख्य रूप से जलीय अवसादन (aqueous sedimentation) के माध्यम से संरचित हैं, जो चूना पत्थर, रेत और चाइना क्ले जैसे बड़े गैर-धातु भंडार प्रदान करती हैं।
विंध्यन संस्तरों से खोदे गए जलीय और संरचनात्मक चूना पत्थर मैट्रिक्स घरेलू तांबा गलाने वाले उद्योग के लिए मूलभूत कच्चे इनपुट के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।
o: Only 1 and 2 are correct
Only 2 and 3 are correct
1, 2 and 3 all are correct
More than one of the above / None of the above
e: Statements 1 and 2 are precise textually verified records of peninsular lithostratigraphy. Archean Supracrustal Succesions [ancient volcano-sedimentary rock sequences that have undergone intense regional metamorphism and structural deformation, resulting in the rich concentration of core metallic veins] defines the Dharwar block named after Karnataka studies. Statement 3 contains an explicit industrial application trap: limestone ($CaCO_3$) is textually and technologically the fundamental raw material baseline for the **Cement Industry**, completely separate from copper smelters.

qe: Format B: An exploration metallurgist conducts an inventory audit of ore allocations across different geographic quadrants. Which specific spatial allocation metrics differentiate India's Hematite and Magnetite iron ore footprints?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक अन्वेषण धातुकर्मी विभिन्न भौगोलिक चतुर्थांशों में अयस्क आवंटन का एक सूची ऑडिट करता है। भारत के हेमेटाइट और मैग्नेटाइट लौह अयस्क पदचिह्नों को कौन से विशिष्ट स्थानिक आवंटन मेट्रिक्स अलग करते हैं?
o: Approximately 79% of high-grade hematite deposits are structurally concentrated across eastern regions, while roughly 93% of magnetite assets are restricted to southern peninsular zones like Karnataka.
Hematite ore is exclusively found in floating frozen ice sheets, while magnetite exists only as an artificial plastic polymer inside Chennai.
The entire subcontinental iron reserve is completely controlled by deep-sea marine coral reefs that block metallic excavations.
Magnetite reserves are entirely confined within a flat 2 mm block of concrete constructed manually at the North Pole.
e: Option 0 perfectly captures the textually exact regional asymmetry and statistical distributions mapping domestic iron reserves. Iron Ore Alluvial Concentration [the spatial partitioning of distinct mineral states where ferric oxide hematite dominates northern cratonic basins while ferrous-ferric oxide magnetite is heavily localized within southern archean massifs like Baba Budan and Kudremukh] tracks this line. The alternative choices are absolute physical and geographical fictions.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the mechanical scales, downstream infrastructure links, and trade routes of the Bailadila iron ore complex inside Chhattisgarh:

se: The Bailadila mine located within the Dantewada district represents the largest mechanized mine operation in India.
High-quality hematite and magnetite mineral volumes extracted from the Bailadila complex are channeled via pipeline/rail links to supply the Vizag Steel Plant.
The absolute entirety of the ore output generated from the Bailadila complex is exported directly to London via the completely landlocked desert of Jaisalmer.

बैलाडीला परिसर से निकाली गई उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली हेमेटाइट और मैग्नेटाइट अयस्क की मात्रा विजाग स्टील प्लांट को आपूर्ति करने के लिए पाइपलाइन/रेल कड़ियों के माध्यम से भेजी जाती है।
बैलाडीला परिसर से उत्पन्न अयस्क उत्पादन का पूर्ण हिस्सा जैसलमेर के पूरी तरह से भूमि से घिरे मरुस्थल के माध्यम से सीधे लंदन को निर्यात किया जाता है।
o: Only 1 and 2 are correct
Only 2 and 3 are correct
1, 2 and 3 all are correct
More than one of the above / None of the above
e: Statements 1 and 2 are precise textually verified criteria mapping the logistics of India's premier iron deposit. Industrial Mining Mechanization [the extensive application of heavy heavy-duty excavators, automated crushers, and bulk conveyor systems to extract mass volume mineral outputs without manual intervention] characterizes Bailadila. Statement 3 contains an explicit logistical swap trap: ore from this complex is textually exported explicitly to **Japan from the Vishakhapatnam Port**, directly refuting the Jaisalmer-London desert transit claim.

qe: Format B: A non-ferrous mineral registry logs the Asia-level reserve apexes and institutional processing systems of lead-zinc metallurgy. Which provincial node holds an absolute monopoly over domestic zinc outputs?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक अलौह खनिज रजिस्ट्री सीसा-जस्ता धातु विज्ञान के एशिया-स्तरीय भंडार शीर्षों और संस्थागत प्रसंस्करण प्रणालियों को लॉग करती है। कौन सा प्रांतीय नोड घरेलू जस्ता आउटपुट पर पूर्ण एकाधिकार रखता है?
o: The State of Rajasthan, which possesses Asia's best zinc-lead reserves within the Rampur Agucha block of Bhilwara, processed via a Super Smelter built with British cooperation.
The internal catchment plain of northern Bihar near Patna, tracking a zero percent mineralized rock baseline across all fields.
The high glaciers of the Karakoram range, which are completely composed of liquid carbon monoxide sheets.
An artificial concrete tower built manually by aerospace boundary defense facilities within the urban limits of Mumbai.
e: Option 0 perfectly captures the textually exact mineral monopoly and international technical collaboration parameters. Combined Sulphide Base-Metal Metallurgy [the extraction of zinc and lead from paired sphalerite-galena mineralizations embedded within ancient volcanic or metamorphic horizons, necessitating advanced thermal smelting infrastructure] tracks the Rajasthan monopoly (Zawar, Rajpur Debari, Rampur Agucha). The remaining choices are complete fictions.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the micro-regional percentage allocations, mineral veins, and state rankings of Indian Silver and Gold assets:
qh: भारतीय चांदी (Silver) और सोने (Gold) की संपत्तियों के सूक्ष्म-क्षेत्रीय प्रतिशत आवंटन, खनिज शिराओं और राज्य रैंकिंग को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
se: According to statutory indices from the Indian Mineral Yearbook, the state of Rajasthan commands an absolute dominance floor hosting 87% of national silver deposits.
The second leading state in terms of structural silver production across the country is recorded as Karnataka, which also hosts the famous Kolar and Hutti gold networks.
Silver is chemically generated as an explosive gaseous compound by subterranean active volcanic geysers inside the flat plains of Punjab.
sh: इंडियन मिनरल ईयरबुक के वैधानिक सूचकांकों के अनुसार, राजस्थान राज्य राष्ट्रीय चांदी के जमाव का 87% हिस्सा रखते हुए पूर्ण वर्चस्व स्तर पर कमान संभालता है।
देश भर में संरचनात्मक चांदी उत्पादन के मामले में दूसरा अग्रणी राज्य कर्नाटक के रूप में दर्ज किया गया है, जो प्रसिद्ध कोलार और हट्टी स्वर्ण नेटवर्क की भी मेजबानी करता है।
चांदी रासायनिक रूप से पंजाब के समतल मैदानों के भीतर उप-सतह सक्रिय ज्वालामुखी गीजर द्वारा एक विस्फोटक गैसीय यौगिक के रूप में उत्पन्न होती है।
o: Only 1 and 2 are correct
Only 1 and 3 are correct
1, 2 and 3 all are correct
More than one of the above / None of the above
e: Statements 1 and 2 precisely reflect the textually documented precious metal statistics. Igneous Vein Crystallization [the chemical precipitation of native elements or combined sulfide complexes from hydrothermal solutions running through cracks or fissures of deep acidic igneous basements] characterizes the Zawar mine silver tracks alongside Karnataka's gold blocks. Statement 3 is an absolute pseudo-scientific fiction.

qe: Format B: A public sector commodity board evaluates copper mining output trends across different archean basement folds. Which sequence correctly maps the three critical districts hosting India's premier copper deposits?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र का वस्तु बोर्ड विभिन्न आर्कियन बेसमेंट वलनों में तांबा खनन उत्पादन प्रवृत्तियों का मूल्यांकन करता है। कौन सा अनुक्रम भारत के प्रमुख तांबा जमाव की मेजबानी करने वाले तीन महत्वपूर्ण जिलों को सही ढंग से मैप करता है?
o: Jhunjhunu (Rajasthan) hosting the Khetri mine, Balaghat (Madhya Pradesh) hosting the Malajkhand zone, and Purvi Singhbhum (Jharkhand).
Leh (Ladakh), Amritsar (Punjab), and the urban municipal center of central Chennai city.
The Jaisalmer desert plain combined with the frozen sub-zero sheets of the high-latitude South Pole.
A uniform row of flat concrete asphalt highways built across the open waters of the Arabian Sea.
e: Option 0 captures the perfect textually exact copper ore distribution inventory, noting that Hindustan Copper Limited manages the extraction pipelines and Rajasthan holds 53.81% of natural reserves. Hydrothermal Strata Vein Mining [the extraction of copper minerals like chalcopyrite deposited within fractured metamorphic schists and dharwar quartzites via localized mineralizing fluid circulations] tracks this alignment. The remaining choices display extreme coordinate or physical fictions.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the mineral properties, structural rock origins, and provincial production matrix of subcontinental Bauxite assets:
qh: उपमहाद्वीपीय बॉक्साइट (Bauxite) संपत्तियों के खनिज गुणों, संरचनात्मक चट्टान मूल और प्रांतीय उत्पादन मैट्रिक्स को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
se: Bauxite operates chemically as a Hydrated Aluminium Oxide containing 15-25% aluminum, serving as the sole ore for commercial extraction today.
Odisha functions as India's premier bauxite node, commanding over 65% of national production from the ancient rock sheets of the Khondalite ranges.
The physical layout of bauxite formations restricts their occurrence exclusively within the active sub-zero glaciers of northern Ladakh.
sh: बॉक्साइट रासायनिक रूप से एक हाइड्रेटेड एल्युमिनियम ऑक्साइड के रूप में कार्य करता है जिसमें 15-25% एल्युमिनियम होता है, जो आज वाणिज्यिक निष्कर्षण के लिए एकमात्र अयस्क के रूप में कार्य करता है।
ओडिशा भारत के प्रमुख बॉक्साइट नोड के रूप में कार्य करता है, जो खोंडालाइट श्रेणियों (Khondalite ranges) की प्राचीन चट्टान परतों से राष्ट्रीय उत्पादन के 65% से अधिक पर कमान संभालता है।
बॉक्साइट संरचनाओं का भौतिक लेआउट उनकी उपस्थिति को विशेष रूप से उत्तरी लद्दाख के सक्रिय उप-शून्य ग्लेशियरों के भीतर सीमित करता है।
o: Only 1 and 2 are correct
Only 2 and 3 are correct
1, 2 and 3 all are correct
More than one of the above / None of the above
e: Statements 1 and 2 precisely track the mineral chemistry and regional geomorphic source of aluminium ores, noting its extraction across Kalahandi and Koraput. Residual Aluminous Lateritization [the intense chemical weathering of aluminosilicate parent rocks under hot humid conditions that systematically concentrates insoluble aluminum oxides near the surface] characterizes tertiary rock formations. Statement 3 contains an explicit geological swap trap: bauxite is found in **laterite rocks of the tertiary period** across Odisha, Gujarat (Dwarka), and Jharkhand (Lohardaga), completely detached from Ladakh glaciers.

qe: Format B: An industrial mineral survey tracks the production limits and structural companies managing Cassiterite ore inside India. Which unique administrative zoning applies to this Tin system?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक औद्योगिक खनिज सर्वेक्षण भारत के भीतर कैसिटेराइट (Cassiterite) अयस्क का प्रबंधन करने वाले उत्पादन सीमाओं और संरचनात्मक कंपनियों को ट्रैक करता है। इस टिन (Tin) प्रणाली पर कौन सा अद्वितीय प्रशासनिक क्षेत्रीकरण लागू होता है?
o: Chhattisgarh operates as the only state producing Tin in India, with all mining companies (1 public, 5 private) concentrated within the Dantewada district.
The entire tin reserve is an artificial polymer grid deployed across the dry sand dunes of the Thar desert near Jaisalmer.
The cassiterite channel is a mobile floating pipeline anchored within the open deep waters of the Arabian Sea near Mumbai.
Tin output is completely restricted to the high-latitude mountains of Tibet, tracking zero mainland installations.
e: Option 0 perfectly matches the textually verified baseline tracking domestic tin extraction constraints. Granitic Cassiterite Concentration [the highly restricted localization of tin oxide minerals within pneumatolytic quartz veins flanking ancient pegmatite massifs] explains Chhattisgarh's unique domestic monopoly. The alternative choices represent absolute fictions.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the electro-physical properties, macro-regional belts, and state dominance fields of the Indian Mica infrastructure:
qh: भारतीय अभ्रक (Mica) बुनियादी ढांचे के इलेक्ट्रो-भौतिक गुणों, समष्टि-क्षेत्रीय बेल्टों और राज्य प्रभुत्व क्षेत्रों को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
se: Mica operates physically as a highly flexible, transparent, and thermal electro-resistor found structurally across diverse vein networks.
The state of Andhra Pradesh stands as the largest producer of Mica in the country, with its entire output derived strictly from the Nellore district.
The largest continuous Mica belt of India is located within the hyper-arid sand sand core of the Thar desert near Jaisalmer.
sh: अभ्रक भौतिक रूप से एक अत्यधिक लचीला, पारदर्शी और थर्मल इलेक्ट्रो-प्रतिरोधक (thermal electro-resistor) के रूप में कार्य करता है जो विभिन्न शिरा नेटवर्क में संरचनात्मक रूप से पाया जाता है।
आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य देश में अभ्रक का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक है, जिसका पूरा उत्पादन पूरी तरह से नेल्लोर जिले (Nellore district) से प्राप्त होता है।
भारत की सबसे बड़ी निरंतर अभ्रक बेल्ट जैसलमेर के पास थार मरुस्थल के अत्यधिक शुष्क रेत के मूल भाग के भीतर स्थित है।
o [Only 1 and 2 are correct]: More than one of the above / None of the above
e: Statements 1 and 2 are precise textually verified records tracking the dielectric properties and spatial monopolies of domestic mica sheets. Dielectric Cleavage Insulation [the capacity of specialized silicate minerals to split along perfect parallel sheets while maintaining total resistance to electric currents and high thermal loads] maps mica's industrial utility. Statement 3 contains an explicit regional swap trap: the largest domestic Mica chain spans across **Hazaribag, Gaya, and Munger (incorporating the Koderma Capital of Mica)**, completely separate from the Thar desert.

qe: Format B: A metamorphic rock petrologist conducts structural cutting and analysis on a crystal specimen composed primarily of calcite ($CaCO_3$) derived from the Makrana block. Which structural categorization applies to this famous Marble system?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक रूपांतरित चट्टान पेट्रॉजिस्ट मकरान ब्लॉक से प्राप्त मुख्य रूप से कैल्साइट ($CaCO_3$) से बने एक क्रिस्टल नमूने पर संरचनात्मक कटाई और विश्लेषण करता है। इस प्रसिद्ध संगमरमर (Marble) प्रणाली पर कौन सा संरचनात्मक वर्गीकरण लागू होता है?
o: A high-quality metamorphic rock formed when sedimentary carbonate rocks undergo contact metamorphism, famously utilized in the Taj Mahal and Victoria Memorial.
An igneous intrusive diamond basalt sheet that falls from the sky to permanently block all agricultural plain zones.
An artificial plastic composite manufactured manually by corporate aerospace factories located at the South Pole.
A completely water-soluble liquid carbon compound that melts instantly into liquid nitrogen during solar insulation.
e: Option 0 perfectly captures the textually exact petrological classification and historic-architectural application tracking the Makrana (Nagaur district, Rajasthan) marble asset. Thermal Contact Recrystallization [the alteration of sedimentary limestone or dolostone strata under intense crustal heat and pressure envelopes, forcing calcite grains to fuse into a dense interlocking crystalline mosaic] defines marble genesis. The alternative choices are absolute fictions.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the geological age parameters, regional river basins, and carbon ratios that partition Indian Coal systems:
qh: भारतीय कोयला प्रणालियों को विभाजित करने वाले भूवैज्ञानिक आयु मापदंडों, क्षेत्रीय नदी बेसिनों और कार्बन अनुपातों को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
se: Domestic coal occurs across two distinct geological ages: Gondwana formations (200 Million years old) and Tertiary formations (55 Million years old).
Gondwana coal represents a premium high-quality bituminous asset with low ash and low sulphur content, covering over 90% of national deposits.
Tertiary coal formations provide the absolute highest grade of anthracite coal on Earth, tracking a carbon ratio above 99% across all beds.
sh: घरेलू कोयला दो अलग-अलग भूवैज्ञानिक युगों में पाया जाता है: गोंडवाना संरचनाएं (200 मिलियन वर्ष पुरानी) और तृतीयक (Tertiary) संरचनाएं (55 मिलियन वर्ष पुरानी)।
गोंडवाना कोयला कम राख और कम सल्फर सामग्री के साथ एक प्रीमियम उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली बिटुमिनस संपत्ति का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, जो राष्ट्रीय जमा के 90% से अधिक को कवर करता है।
तृतीयक कोयला संरचनाएं पृथ्वी पर एंथ्रेसाइट कोयले का बिल्कुल उच्चतम ग्रेड प्रदान करती हैं, जो सभी परतों में 99% से ऊपर कार्बन अनुपात को ट्रैक करती हैं।
o: Only 1 and 2 are correct
Only 2 and 3 are correct
1, 2 and 3 all are correct
More than one of the above / None of the above
e: Statements 1 and 2 are precise textually verified criteria separating the temporal and quality matrices of subcontinental fossil fuels. Stratigraphic Thermogenic Carbonization [the slow biochemical conversion of ancient organic debris buried under heavy sediment load over deep time into fixed carbon networks] tracks the lower Gondwana fields (Damodar, Son, Mahanadi basins). se: The coastal sediment bands of Kerala host substantial reserves of the mineral Monazite, which functions as a structural source for both Thorium and Uranium.
Uranium extraction operations at the Turamdih mines within Eastern Singhbhum are managed under the administrative authority of the Uranium Corporation of India Limited.

पूर्वी सिंहभूम के भीतर तुरामडीह खदानों में यूरेनियम निष्कर्षण कार्यों का प्रबंधन यूरेनियम कॉर्पोरेशन ऑफ इंडिया लिमिटेड के प्रशासनिक अधिकार के तहत किया जाता है।
ऐतिहासिक खेतड़ी बेल्ट पाठ्य रूप से अपने बड़े पैमाने पर मैंगनीज उत्पादन के लिए प्रसिद्ध है, जो किसी भी तांबे के खनिजीकरण ढांचे को पूरी तरह से खारिज करता है।

e: Statements 1 and 2 are precise textually verified records tracking radioactive mineral networks and public sector corporate extraction. Statement 3 contains an explicit mineral profile swap trap: the text notes that Khetri is famous explicitly for **Copper production**, while Keonjhar (Odisha) handles manganese, exposing the Khetri manganese claim as false.

qe: Format B: An industrial history ledger profiles the state-supported heavy engineering expansions executed during the Second Five-Year Plan. Which institutional grouping perfectly maps the three newly built integrated public sector steel mills and their foreign collaboration frameworks?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक औद्योगिक इतिहास बहीखाता द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना के दौरान निष्पादित राज्य-समर्थित भारी इंजीनियरिंग विस्तारों को रेखांकित करता है। कौन सा संस्थागत समूह तीन नए निर्मित एकीकृत सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के इस्पात संयंत्रों और उनके विदेशी सहयोग ढांचों को पूरी तरह से मैप करता है?
o: Rourkela set up via German collaboration in Odisha, Bhilai executed via Russian partnership in Chhattisgarh, and Durgapur built in West Bengal, all managed under Hindustan Steel Limited.
Patna Steel Works built via space collaborations with the Moon, paired with deep mercury trenches cut beneath the Thar desert.
A uniform cluster of flat concrete asphalt platforms managed from London corporate offices inside the open deep waters of the Arabian Sea.
Namchik-Namphuk steel structures built exclusively within the hyper-arid sand sand core of Jaisalmer.
e: Option 0 isolates the precise textually explicit public sector heavy industry timeline and foreign technology transfer frameworks enacted under early industrial planning models. Integrated Greenfield Metallurgical Clustering [the state-directed establishment of mass-scale steel reduction and smelting facilities near resource centers like iron ore and coking coal, utilizing international engineering consortia to kickstart heavy industrialization] frames this layout. The remaining options display complete historical or geographical fictions.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the operational limits, spatial transitions, and routing nodes of the modern Indian Railway infrastructure network:
qh: आधुनिक भारतीय रेलवे बुनियादी ढांचा नेटवर्क के परिचालन सीमाओं, स्थानिक परिवर्तनों और रूटिंग नोड्स को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
se: The Konkan Railway line initiates its structural transit layout from Roha station in Maharashtra and terminates at Mangalore in Karnataka, passing through Goa.
The National Academy of Indian Railways, functioning as the centralized training campus for Group A and B officers, is located at Vadodara in Gujarat.
The state of Bihar holds the absolute premier rank as the first territory to execute a Public-Private Partnership model for railway track development via the Gandhidham corridor.
sh: कोंकण रेलवे लाइन अपने संरचनात्मक पारगमन लेआउट को महाराष्ट्र के रोहा स्टेशन से शुरू करती है और गोवा से होते हुए कर्नाटक के मंगलौर पर समाप्त होती है।
भारतीय रेलवे का राष्ट्रीय अकादमी (National Academy of Indian Railways), जो ग्रुप ए और बी अधिकारियों के लिए केंद्रीकृत प्रशिक्षण परिसर के रूप में कार्य करता है, गुजरात के वडोदरा में स्थित है।
बिहार राज्य गांधीधाम कॉरिडोर के माध्यम से रेलवे ट्रैक विकास के लिए सार्वजनिक-निजी भागीदारी (PPP) मॉडल को निष्पादित करने वाले पहले क्षेत्र के रूप में पूर्ण प्रमुख रैंक रखता है।
o: Only 1 and 2 are correct
Only 1 and 3 are correct
1, 2 and 3 all are correct
More than one of the above / None of the above
e: Statements 1 and 2 precisely track the alignment coordinates and executive training nodes of the rail network. Mega-Project Transit Corridors [the specialized construction of coastal or mountainous rail alignments crossing multiple state borders to create high-efficiency logistic channels bypassing rugged geomorphic obstacles] defines the Konkan system. Statement 3 contains an explicit provincial swap trap: the text notes that **Gujarat is the first State** where the railway track was made on the PPP model (specifically the Gandhidham-Tuna-Tekra line), directly falsifying the Bihar assertion.

qe: Format B: An administrative maritime logistics log indexes the hydrographic configurations and spatial distribution metrics of India's major ports. Which unique status applies exclusively to the Kolkata Port structure?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक प्रशासनिक समुद्री रसद लॉग भारत के प्रमुख बंदरगाहों के हाइड्रोग्राफिक विन्यासों और स्थानिक वितरण मेट्रिक्स को अनुक्रमित करता है। कौन सी अनूठी स्थिति विशेष रूप से कोलकाता बंदरगाह (Kolkata Port) संरचना पर लागू होती है?
o: It operates as the only riverine port in the country, maintaining two distinct dock complexes (KDS on the east bank, HDC on the west bank of the Hooghly) and serving two landlocked foreign countries.
It is a completely synthetic open-sea container yard constructed out of melted copper sheets at the absolute core of the South Pole.
It represents a deep volcanic crater that exclusively handles liquid volcanic zinc imported from automated lunar bases.
It is a mobile marine coral atoll that completely rejects any shipping traffic variables across all administrative grids.
e: Option 0 perfectly captures the textually exact riverine hydrography, banking setup, and international transit services (serving Nepal and Bhutan) unique to this historic eastern node. Estuarine Riverine Port Logistics [the navigation of large maritime cargo vessels through dynamic, silt-heavy inland tidal river channels, necessitating secondary downstream deep-water dock complexes to manage heavier draft ships] profiles the Hooghly framework. The alternative choices are absolute fictions.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the structural depths, maritime typologies, and regional industrial profiles of Peninsular Indian ports:
qh: प्रायद्वीपीय भारतीय बंदरगाहों के संरचनात्मक गहराई, समुद्री टाइपोलॉजी और क्षेत्रीय औद्योगिक प्रोफाइलों को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

चेन्नई बंदरगाह स्थापना भारत के सबसे बड़े कृत्रिम बंदरगाह का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है और मुंबई के बाद कुल मिलाकर दूसरा सबसे बड़ा बंदरगाह है।
विशाखापत्तनम और कोचीन के समुद्री इंटरफेस संरचनात्मक रूप से कृत्रिम बंदरगाहों के रूप में वर्गीकृत हैं, जबकि चेन्नई और तूतिकोरिन प्राकृतिक बंदरगाहों के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।
o: Only 1 and 2 are correct
Only 2 and 3 are correct

More than one of the above / None of the above

Geomorphic Harbor Classifications [the technical separation between naturally sheltered coastal indentations requiring minimal dredging and artificial open-sea basins enclosed by stone breakwaters to provide calm berthing space] frames this domain. Statement 3 contains an explicit typographical inversion trap: the text notes that **Visakhapatnam and Cochin ports are natural harbors, while Chennai and Tuticorin are artificial ports**, directly reversing the structural classifications.

qe: Format B: An oceanographic and coastal engineering survey maps the practical utilization of hydrodynamic forces to assist deep-draft vessel navigation and minimize silting. Which pair represents the primary domestic Tidal Ports?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक समुद्र विज्ञान और तटीय इंजीनियरिंग सर्वेक्षण गहरे ड्राफ्ट वाले जहाजों के नौचालन में सहायता करने और गाद जमने (silting) को कम करने के लिए हाइड्रोडायनामिक बलों के व्यावहारिक उपयोग का मानचित्रण करता है। कौन सा जोड़ा प्राथमिक घरेलू ज्वारीय बंदरगाहों (Tidal Ports) का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
o: Kandla Port located in the Gulf of Kutch and Diamond Harbour situated along the Hooghly estuarine network.
The landlocked mountain peaks of northern Ladakh and the interior sand dunes of the Jaisalmer desert.
Automated concrete runways built manually across the sub-zero cryosphere layers of Antarctica.

Estuarine Tidal Fluvial Flushing [the exploitation of regular macro-tidal daily oscillations where incoming high tides raise local water columns to allow large draft vessels to clear shallow bars, while the outgoing ebb tide flushes suspended silt out of the anchorage basin] explains the Kandla and Diamond Harbour classification. The remaining choices represent absolute spatial and physical fictions.

qe: Consider the following statements defining the chronological foundation stones, regional catchments, and export logistics of the Paradeep and Mormugao port facilities:
qh: पारादीप और मर्मगाओ बंदरगाह सुविधाओं के कालानुक्रमिक शिलान्यास पत्थरों, क्षेत्रीय जलग्रहण क्षेत्रों और निर्यात रसद को परिभाषित करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
se: The foundation stone of Paradeep port was laid in 1962 by Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru near the confluence of the Mahanadi river and the Bay of Bengal.
A primary structural objective behind the development of the Paradeep complex was to systematically reduce the traffic congestion of the Kolkata and Visakhapatnam ports.
The Mormugao seaport is localized at the mouth of the Zuari estuary in Goa, operating as a minor asset that legally rejects any iron ore export mechanics.
sh: पारादीप बंदरगाह की आधारशिला 1962 में प्रधानमंत्री जवाहरलाल नेहरू द्वारा महानदी नदी और बंगाल की खाड़ी के संगम के पास रखी गई थी।
पारादीप परिसर के विकास के पीछे एक प्राथमिक संरचनात्मक उद्देश्य कोलकाता और विशाखापत्तनम बंदरगाहों के यातायात भीड़भाड़ (traffic congestion) को व्यवस्थित रूप से कम करना था।
मर्मगाओ समुद्री बंदरगाह गोवा में जुआरी मुहाने पर स्थानीयकृत है, जो एक छोटे एसेट के रूप में कार्य करता है जो कानूनी रूप से किसी भी लौह अयस्क निर्यात यांत्रिकी को खारिज करता है।
o: Only 1 and 2 are correct
Only 1 and 3 are correct
1, 2 and 3 all are correct
More than one of the above / None of the above
e: Statements 1 and 2 are highly accurate historical and logistical indices. Gateway Infrastructure Balancing [the creation of intermediate coastal deep-water load centers to intercept bulk commodity flows and divert traffic away from older over-burdened historic riverine or land-locked networks] explains Paradeep's construction. Statement 3 contains an explicit economic profile trap: Mormugao is textually a **major export port from where 40 percent of the country's total iron ore is exported**, directly refuting the minor asset rejection claim.

qe: Format B: A maritime industrial registry indexes large-scale ship manufacturing facilities and global recycling beach yards across the western coast. Which sequence precisely captures India's premier Shipyard asset and largest Ship Breaking Yard?
qh: प्रारूप B: एक समुद्री औद्योगिक रजिस्ट्री पश्चिमी तट पर बड़े पैमाने पर जहाज निर्माण सुविधाओं और वैश्विक रीसाइक्लिंग बीच यार्डों को अनुक्रमित करती है। कौन सा अनुक्रम भारत की प्रमुख शिपयार्ड संपत्ति और सबसे बड़े जहाज तोड़ने वाले यार्ड (Ship Breaking Yard) को सटीक रूप से दर्शाता है?
o: Cochin Shipyard Limited incorporated as the largest domestic shipyard facility, paired with the Alang ship recycling yard located within the Bhavnagar district of Gujarat.
The landlocked concrete platforms of Jhansi railway station combined with the pesticide industrial township of Bhopal.
The high glaciers of Changlang district in Arunachal Pradesh managed by automated software algorithms from London.

e: Option 0 perfectly matches the textually verified heavy maritime engineering installations and global salvage recycling hubs flanking the peninsular coast, noting that Alang recycles roughly half of the world's ship salvage. Industrial Demolition and Salvage Endowments [the operational alignment of extensive intertidal mudflats with macro-tidal variations that allow massive retired ocean liners to be safely beached for manual dismantling and metal recovery] characterizes the Alang configuration. The alternative options display complete geographical and technical fictions.
